svg.text: URL occurrences per day — stacked bar; top hosts colored individually, long tail in grey "other"
Sources: prowiki + apchem + wiki4d + ludism + milkwiki + texteditors + pastes + gems + popcat-wayback + per-site paste scrapes. Y-axis is log10; hosts in the same category share a hue.
colored by host; hosts in the same category share a hue with lightness variation.
